references.text: Abidan, son of Gideoni, is first mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Benjamin at the census.
Abidan, son of Gideoni, is the leader of the camp of Benjamin in the arrangement of the camps.
Abidan, son of Gideoni, brings his offering on the ninth day at the dedication of the altar.
Benjamin was born as Jacob's youngest son, and the tribe was named after him.
The sons of Benjamin who went to Egypt show the origin of the tribe.
